messages:
Maya K: Morning — planning to enable feature flag 'session_affinity_v2' as a canary in EU for 10% of traffic tomorrow 10:00 PT. Quick sanity check: canary audiences, guardrails, fallback model/region behavior? Will also run sticky TTL change from 60s->300s. pinging infra & oncall. :eyes:

Theo L: Are we targeting orgs or sessions? If orgs, we need consent re: GDPR sticky cookies. If sessions, how do we guarantee KV cache locality? Also what's the expected p95 latency delta?

Priya S: Recommended canary audience = new_signups + <5k MAU orgs. Keep to 10% of requests, and block high-cost models (no 8k-decoder) for canary. Add circuit-breaker at 5% error increase.

Alex R: Product ask — include fallback to model 'redwood-small-v1' in eu-west-1 if regional capacity spikes. Need rollout bucket mapping so EU users stay in-region unless capacity triggers fallback.

Maya K: Copy. Here's the rollout JSON I'm proposing:
```json
{
  "flag": "session_affinity_v2",
  "percent": 10,
  "audience": ["new_signups", "<5k_orgs"],
  "sticky_ttl_seconds": 300,
  "fallback_policy": {
    "on_high_latency": "route-to-eu-west-1-redwood-small-v1",
    "on_capacity": "route-to-alt-region"
  }
}
```
Link to runbook + smoke tests: https://go.internal/runbooks/session-affinity-rollout

Theo L: Minor nit — add explicit header for model blacklist in canary to avoid accidental heavy-model routing:
```yaml
blacklist_models: ["redwood-8k-decoder", "redwood-llm-xlarge"]
```

deploy-bot: Canary flag 'session_affinity_v2' scheduled: 2026-03-18T17:00:00Z for channel eng-platform. :bell:

Priya S: I'll add automated regression alert in perf-alerting for token_latency_p95 and error_rate. If p95 increases > 8% or error_rate > 0.5% for 10m, trigger rollback.

Maya K: Great — will push PR with config now @Theo L @Priya S @Alex R. If no objections, we'll unpause for the canary tomorrow. :thumbsup:

Theo L: Looks good to me. One more thing: document the expected KV cache hit-rate baseline in the runbook.

Alex R: No objections from Product. :+1:

Maya K: PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/merge/1234 — comments welcomed. Last message: I'll post a final preflight 30m before the toggle.

deploy-bot: PR merged by Maya K — roll flag will run at scheduled time.
